verdict.rationale: GitLab docs claim AI agents can turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities, with security findings surfaced in MRs/IDEs, directly supporting automated fix generation. However, evidence is limited to marketing claims with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the vulnerability-remediation agent actually working, and no detail on scope/reliability of auto-applying fixes. Missing for 10: independent verification of the remediation agent's effectiveness, detailed documentation of the auto-fix workflow, and community/hands-on evidence confirming real-world success.
